name: Despawner

length.label: Length (m)
length.desc: Local X extent of the volume that removes cargo. Cargo vanishes as soon as it is inside, so cover the full lane width or things slip past the edge.

width.label: Width (m)
width.desc: Local Z extent of the volume that removes cargo.

height.label: Height (m)
height.desc: Local Y extent of the volume that removes cargo.

countOnly.label: Count only
countOnly.desc: Count just this product, so a tote carrying a case counts once. Everything in the mouth is still removed. (none) counts every body that goes in.

countTag.label: Throughput count tag
countTag.desc: Running total of everything this despawner has removed, published for the program to read. It only ever climbs, so take differences over time to get a rate.

rateTag.label: Throughput rate tag
rateTag.desc: Items removed per minute of simulated time, averaged over the whole run so far.

cycleTag.label: Average cycle time tag
cycleTag.desc: Average time, in simulated seconds, from an item coming into being (spawned, or already in the scene when the run started) to its removal here. 0 until the first item arrives.

blockTag.label: Block tag (pause removal while true)
blockTag.desc: While the program holds this true, nothing is removed and cargo backs up into the mouth - the way to model a downstream line that has stopped taking product.
